project_3d_points_to_2d_fisheye: project 3D points to 2D image coordinates using the Fisheye624 camera model with radial tangential and thin prism distortion
unproject_2d_pixels_to_3d_rays_fisheye: unproject 2D pixel coordinates to 3D rays using the Fisheye624 camera model with Newton method optimization
project_3d_points_to_2d_pinhole: project 3D points to 2D image coordinates using the simple pinhole camera model with focal length and principal point
unproject_2d_pixels_to_3d_rays_pinhole: unproject 2D pixel coordinates to 3D rays using the simple pinhole camera model
compute_safe_sign_for_tensor: compute a safe sign tensor that returns positive one for zero values to avoid division by zero
